name: Stripe Invoicing
summary: Stripe Invoicing creates invoices from the Stripe Dashboard or API and lets customers pay on a Stripe-hosted invoice page. It charges 0.4% of each paid invoice on the Starter tier, with no fixed fees, and Stripe's payment processing fees apply on top.

facts.text: Invoices move through the statuses draft, open, paid, void and uncollectible.
Customers can pay from a Stripe-hosted invoice page, and an invoice can be sent as a PDF or shared as a link by email or SMS.
Stripe says Invoicing has no fixed fees or setup costs and that Stripe Payments pricing applies in addition to the per-invoice fee.
The Plus tier adds quotes to the Starter features.
Stripe states PCI Service Provider Level 1 certification and annual SOC 1 and SOC 2 Type II reports.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: No fixed fee. Payment processing fees are charged separately

plans.name: Custom
plans.notes: For businesses with large invoice amounts or needs that do not fit the other tiers

hiddenCosts: Stripe Payments processing fees apply to every payment, in addition to the per-invoice fee.
Starter pricing of 0.4% per paid invoice is also shown on Stripe's main pricing page; the Plus tier is listed only on the Invoicing pricing page.

security.ssoPlan: SAML 2.0 single sign-on is supported in the Stripe Dashboard
